definitions.full: H2742. charuwts I. חָרוּץ adjective sharp, diligent (on this and following see Ba NB 173 ) — חָרוּץ Isa 28:27 11 t.; plural חֲרוּצִים Prov 10:4 ; 12:24 ; חֲרֻצִים 13:4 ; חֲרֻצוֺת Amos 1:3 ; — 1 sharp: of threshing instrument ח ׳מוֺרָג חָדָשׁ Isa 41:15 ; without ׳מ , as substantive, 28:27 (where יוּדַשׁ ); ׳ח הַבַּרְזֶל Amos 1:3 ; Job 41:22 (figurative of crocodile). 2 figurative diligent: as substantive Prov 21:5 ; opposed to רְמִיָּךְ 10:4 ; 12:24 , 27 ; opposed to עָצֵּל 13:4 . — Dan 9:25 see IV. חרוץ . II. חָרוּץ noun [masculine] strict decision , only הֶחָרוּץ עֵמֶק Joel Dan 4:14 (twice in verse) valley of strict decision (see Ba l.c .).
